question: Should CodexBar support a persisted Claude-provider option that lets a single claude-swap account intentionally replace ambient Claude presentation?
rationale: The patch is opt-in and preserves existing defaults, but it expands the supported provider configuration contract and changes which account source users can select for a one-account setup.

options.title: Accept the opt-in setting
options.body: Merge after the pending platform checks pass, preserving the default two-account behavior while enabling an explicit one-account preference.

options.title: Keep the existing threshold
options.body: Decline the new configuration surface and retain claude-swap precedence only when two or more accounts are available.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in setting
recommendation.body: Merge after the pending platform checks pass, preserving the default two-account behavior while enabling an explicit one-account preference.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest documentation clarification on this branch is the clearest available signal of ownership for the supported product configuration.
